subject: lk-imp
title: LK.IMP.------LG.DY.
description: Chart 2 of 3 on book p. 300 (PR.S(RD)II-54). LK-IMP (linkage implications) is the subject; LG-DY (logical dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: TR (transformation), PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) and C-CONT (composite continuance). From TR: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From T-C-IMP: WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle). From WO-EXP-PRI: TRS (transition). From PROJ-DY: AF-NT (affinity nature). From AF-NT: ATTN (attraction) and COS-DT. From C-CONT: MT-INFO (multi-information) and TH-CONT (thrust continuance). From MT-INFO: UPB (underlying philosophical basis). From TH-CONT: BIA (bi-aitional).
